kids.text: “Something is breathing behind the morgue door.”

kids.name: Desc
kids.text: A nurse’s penlight, held together with tape. It flickers when the charge runs low — and something always notices.

kids.text: Swap in a <font color="#f2b84b">BATTERY</font>  (×3 in pack)

kids.text: Every kilo slows you down. Every sound draws them closer.
